config.description: Optional Polyrank API key (pk_live_…). Enables the authenticated tools: polyrank_rank_wallets (the Ranking Builder), polyrank_get_trader_metrics, the AI Lab tools and tid resolve. Anonymous tools work without it.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Your Polyrank API key as a bearer token (pk_live_…, from https://polyrank.app/api-keys). Without it the 17 free read-only tools work; the Ranking Builder, per-window trader metrics and the AI Lab tools need it (they also need a paid plan with the AI Lab; results are simulated).
